scene: A warehouse with stacked pallets, forklifts, and an American flag hanging from the ceiling, viewed from an elevated angle.
activity: A person walks into the path of a moving forklift, which then stops abruptly.

candidates.description: A person on foot walks into the travel path of a moving forklift, which stops abruptly to avoid collision.
candidates.evidence: Frame 1: Person walking near forklift. Frame 2: Person closer to forklift. Frame 3: Forklift begins to stop. Frame 4: Forklift stopped, person still in path.

scene: A warehouse with stacked boxes, a forklift, and an American flag hanging from the ceiling, viewed from an elevated angle.
activity: A person walks from the right side of the frame toward the forklift, which moves forward slightly between frames.

candidates.description: A person walks into the path of a moving forklift. The individual is on foot, and the forklift is in motion, with the person positioned in the truck's direction of travel.
candidates.evidence: Frame 1: Forklift stationary, person not visible. Frame 2: Forklift begins moving, person starts walking. Frame 3: Person is closer to the forklift, now in its path. The person is approximately one truck-length ahead of the forklift in Frame 3.
